pains: My face stings the moment I put anything new on it, even stuff that says 'gentle'.
Delhi pollution and then AC all day, my cheeks are red and flaky by evening.
I have like ten half-used products and my skin is still angry.
Every time I try a new serum I break out or get that tight, burning feeling.
Makeup just sits in patches on my dry irritated skin, I can't even go out without feeling conscious.
desires: I just want one simple thing that calms my skin down and doesn't sting.
I want my skin to feel soft and comfortable, not tight by afternoon.
Something light that I can put on in the humid weather without feeling sticky.
I want to stop experimenting and finally trust a product on my face.
A routine that's short, because I'm not doing a 10-step thing every night.
objections: Every brand says 'for sensitive skin', and then I still get a reaction.
Serums feel heavy and greasy on my skin, I hate that, especially in Mumbai humidity.
Is it worth spending on another product when I've already wasted money on so many?
Will it actually repair anything or is it just another moisturiser with a fancy name?
I'm scared to buy online without trying it first, what if it doesn't suit me?
proof_points: It's fragrance-free, so no perfume sitting on your already irritated skin.
It contains ceramides, which is what a barrier repair serum is about.
The texture is lightweight and water-based, so it doesn't feel heavy or sticky.
It's made for sensitive skin, not just labelled as an afterthought.
It comes in a 30 ml bottle.
